fusions.name: Ruinous Gnaw
fusions.desc: Looses a cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 10 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: A crushing bite that deals 8 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Droning Horde
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm for 12 seconds that gnaws the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Gorged Reprieve
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
